Northern Army commander leads high-level security review in Kashmir

The Northern Army commander chaired a high-level security review meeting in Srinagar’s Chinar Core headquarters, reviewing the security situation in Kashmir and discussing real-time intelligence sharing and a winter anti-terror strategy aimed at preventing terrorists from escaping.
